videos.why: The only ready Short. Frame 0 shows the superjumbo's wing on its take-off roll with AIRBUS on the fuselage; the question holds back its answer; it busts the school myth in a wind tunnel and pays off with the 575-tonne take-off weight hanging on air. Close to rank's 5.7; quality is docked for the retries and the 20 s without a close shot.
strengths: A myth most viewers were taught, corrected on screen (two puffs of air, the top one arrives first)
Every step of the cause shown: tilt, downwash, pressure, push-back
Loops straight back into the opening wing shot
risks: The Airbus mark is painted lettering, not the real logo (Commons download refused with HTTP 429)
Only one question between the hook and the payoff
20 s with no close shot in the middle
